loading.subtitle: GATE OF HELL CHRONICLES
loading.msg_3: Recording the names of evil spirits...
loading.msg_4: Sealing the energy of the abyss...

hud.se_tooltip: Soul Energy (SE): Used to summon and upgrade units (Click for details)
hud.pe_tooltip: Portal Erosion (PE): Game Over if it reaches 100% (Click for details)
hud.rs_tooltip: Remaining Spirits (RS): Kills required to clear stage (Click for details)
hud.curse_tooltip_desc_active: High portal erosion has triggered an ancient curse. Purge to lower erosion.
hud.curse_tooltip_desc_dormant: The curse has not yet awakened. Activates when erosion exceeds 30%.
hud.se_tooltip_desc: Spiritual energy required to summon exorcists and build shrines.
hud.pe_tooltip_desc: Erosion that builds up as evil spirits pass through the portal. Game Over at 100%.
hud.rs_tooltip_desc: Total amount of evil spirits that must be killed to clear the current stage.

controls.sf_tooltip: Soul Fragment — Resource for crafting relics
controls.sc_tooltip: Soul Crystal — Resource for equipment reroll
controls.summon_desc: Randomly summons either a Novice or Apprentice Exorcist.
controls.shrine_desc: Place in exclusive slots to provide powerful ATK buffs to nearby allies.
controls.purge_desc: Instantly removes 50% of Portal Erosion. Use in emergencies.
controls.relics_desc: Treasures found during purging that permanently enhance all allies.
controls.equip_desc: Ancient armaments that significantly boost specific stats when equipped.
controls.equip_manage_desc: Manage and enhance sacred equipment obtained from the abyss.
controls.equip_lore: Even a broken blade becomes a divine sword in the hands of an exorcist.
controls.collections_desc: Check detailed records of encountered spirits and allies.
controls.pact_desc_fmt: Instantly summons a boss-level soul. Guarantees a relic on kill. Once every {cd} stages. Penalties accumulate if not summoned for {grace} stages or more.

info_panel.lore_default: The Abyssal Tablet analyzes soul essence to light the path of purification.
info_panel.enemy_desc_unknown: A being of unknown origin from the abyss.
info_panel.enemy_flavor: Its essence lingers briefly on the tablet...
info_panel.slot_warning_flavor: This spot does not allow for soul harmony.
info_panel.enemy_lore_unknown: There is no record of this soul.
info_panel.sacred_slot_only_log: Only Sacred Shrine (Tier 2) can be placed here.
info_panel.tip_promote_desc_random: Spends Soul Energy to awaken into a random higher-tier exorcist.
info_panel.tip_promote_desc_fixed: Spends Soul Energy to promote into the designated higher exorcist.
info_panel.tip_sacrifice_desc: Returns this guardian to the abyss, freeing the slot and refunding some Soul Energy. Cannot be undone.

collections.subtitle: Every being in the abyss is engraved on this tablet
collections.ghost_locked_lore: A being hiding deep within the abyss.

relics.subtitle: Cursed relics harvested from the depths of the abyss
relics.sf_tooltip: Soul Fragment — Resource for crafting relics
relics.craft_btn_title_fmt: Craft random relic using {cost} Soul Fragments (Owned {sf} SF)

equipment.subtitle: Sacred artifacts gathered from the abyss
equipment.sc_row_title: Rarely obtained on kill. Used for rerolling equipment.
equipment.found_lore: Even the spirits of the abyss will be blinded by the light of this armament.
equipment.lore_armory: Even a broken blade becomes a divine sword in the hands of an exorcist.
equipment.droprate_note: Chance per enemy killed. Bosses roll 10x. ★ = bonus stat slots.

game_over.title: Soul Overwhelmed
game_over.msg: The abyss has claimed another soul... The gates have collapsed, and eternal darkness awaits.

sacrifice.body:
Do you wish to forcibly break the sacred contract with the guardian?

The price for returning a soul to the abyss is never light,
and essence once scattered can never be recalled.

Do you truly wish to banish this guardian into eternal darkness?

pause.body:
The flow of the abyss has briefly stopped.
Continue the exorcism when you are ready.

settings.tutorial_desc: Displays help when discovering new units/systems.
settings.sfx_desc: Plays combat and interface sound effects.
settings.music_desc: Background score played in the Dorian mode.
settings.fps_desc: 30 FPS saves battery and reduces heat.

quit.body:
Countless souls have already lost their way on this path.

If even you give up on the exorcism, the remaining light in this world will vanish completely.
All purification records until now will be destroyed and can never be restored.

Do you truly wish to give up on this sacred mission?

section.basic_1: Drag & drop to change the position of your exorcists.
section.basic_2: Click the bottom cards to summon new exorcists or build shrines.
section.units_1: Exorcists automatically attack spirits and can be promoted using SE.
section.units_2: Shrines provide powerful buffs to nearby allies, but cause debuffs when demolished.
section.pe_1: Erosion increases when evil spirits pass through the portal.
section.pe_2: If erosion reaches 100%, the world ends. Use 'Purge' to stop the erosion.

enemy.boss_warning_lore: A powerful ruler of the abyss is descending. Focus all exorcists' power!

curse.form_0_desc: A quietly sleeping statue. It hasn't awakened yet.
curse.form_1_desc: Cracks have started to form. Something is trying to wake up.
curse.form_2_desc: It has opened its eyes. It is watching you.
curse.form_3_desc: It has started to spread its wings. It has entered a state of vigilance.
curse.form_4_desc: Fully awakened. Flames of wrath burn in its eyes.
curse.form_5_desc: Corruption has begun. It is filled with dark power.
curse.form_6_desc: Transformed into a complete demon. Its very existence pollutes the surroundings.
curse.form_7_desc: A corrupt god has descended. All holy power is weakening.

pact.madness_log_on: Demon Horn: Madness Triggered — Damage Bonus ×2

meta.title: Gate of Hell : Return of Evil Spirits
meta.rotate: Please rotate your device to portrait

novice_exorcist.name: Novice Exorcist
novice_exorcist.desc: Attacks single enemy with the power of the sacred book. Exclusive to Support T2 path.
novice_exorcist.lore: A beginner exorcist in lavender robes with short brown hair, emitting light from an open bible.

apprentice.name: Apprentice Exorcist
apprentice.desc: Fires purified energy bolts to attack a single target.
apprentice.lore: An apprentice exorcist in deep indigo robes with golden vestments, holding a cross-engraved holy tool.

acolyte_priest.name: Novice Priest
acolyte_priest.desc: Inflicts holy damage on a single enemy with blessing light. Can be promoted to Support T2 like Slow/Insight.
acolyte_priest.lore: A novice priest in white robes with dove feathers, emitting light of blessing.

acolyte_warrior.name: Novice Warrior
acolyte_warrior.desc: Deals melee damage with a consecrated dagger. Can be promoted to Attack T2 like Sword/Monk/Hymn.
acolyte_warrior.lore: An agile apprentice warrior in light armor with a consecrated dagger and glowing charms on shoulders.

chainer.name: Soul Binder
chainer.desc: Fires spiritual chains to deal damage and reduce enemy movement speed by 30%.
chainer.lore: A binder in grey robes wrapped in black chains, with blue spiritual energy flowing from the chains.

talisman.name: Talisman Master
talisman.desc: Throws exploding talismans to deal area damage at the point of impact.
talisman.lore: A master in yellow robes with explosive talismans on shoulders and waist, sparks at fingertips.

monk.name: Mace Monk
monk.desc: Strikes with a heavy mace to push evil spirits away from the portal.
monk.lore: A sturdy monk in reddish-brown robes carrying a golden mace, with a holy seal on forehead.

archer.name: Sacred Archer
archer.desc: Fires long-range precision arrows that partially ignore enemy defense. [Apprentice Exorcist exclusive]
archer.lore: A precision marksman in platinum chainmail with a glowing bowstring and holy runes on arrowheads.

ice.name: Frost Taoist
ice.desc: Chants freezing spells to significantly reduce enemy movement speed for 2 seconds.
ice.lore: A frost taoist in blue-white coat with a frost crystal staff, breath condensing coldly.

fire.name: Fire Mage
fire.desc: Burns enemies to deal burn damage equal to 1% of max HP every second.
fire.lore: A fire mage in crimson robes with a flame-patterned hood, rolling small embers on palms.

assassin.name: Shadow Assassin
assassin.desc: Quickly slashes with twin blades, ignoring all enemy defense. [Apprentice Exorcist exclusive]
assassin.lore: An agile shadow in a black hood and white mask, holding curved twin blades.

tracker.name: Soul Tracker
tracker.desc: Shines a guiding light to expand the attack range of all nearby allies.
tracker.lore: A hunter-style tracker in a silver cloak with a tracking lantern, eyes glowing blue.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.desc: Summons spiritual energy walls to physically block the path of evil spirits. [Novice Exorcist exclusive]
necromancer.lore: A necromancer in a purple hood with a skull-decorated staff, emitting soul mist from fingertips.

guardian.name: Shrine Guardian
guardian.desc: Attacks with holy power, with a 5% chance to instantly banish the target. [Novice Warrior exclusive]
guardian.lore: A steadfast guardian in white chainmail with a golden cross shield and consecrated sword.

alchemist.name: Exorcist Alchemist
alchemist.desc: Transmutes enemy essence, with a 15% chance to gain 2 SE on hit. [Novice Exorcist exclusive]
alchemist.lore: An alchemist in a leather apron with a vial belt, holding a bubbling purification flask.

mirror.name: Mirror Prophet
mirror.desc: Uses reflection magic to bounce 30% of damage dealt to other nearby enemies. [Novice Exorcist exclusive]
mirror.lore: A mysterious prophet in silver clothing with a hand mirror, the surface shimmering in rainbow colors.

knight.name: Exorcist Knight
knight.desc: Swings a blessed greatsword to deal balanced physical and holy damage.
knight.lore: A knight in bronze plate armor with a consecrated greatsword and a holy cross cloak.

verse_warrior.name: Scripture Warrior
verse_warrior.desc: Strikes with holy scripture beads, with a 10% chance to root enemy movement for 1 second. [Novice Warrior exclusive]
verse_warrior.lore: A warrior in white martial arts robes with rosaries wrapped around hands, striking with scripture beads.

hymn_blaster.name: Hymn Blaster
hymn_blaster.desc: Rapidly fires explosive hymn waves to deal damage to groups of enemies. [Novice Priest exclusive]
hymn_blaster.lore: A massive blaster in golden priest robes carrying a giant hymn trumpet cannon.

exorcism_mage.name: Exorcism Mage
exorcism_mage.desc: Concentrates exorcism energy for a powerful single strike. [Novice Priest exclusive]
exorcism_mage.lore: A mage in deep blue robes with a cross staff, gathering condensed white light at fingertips.

lightning_mage.name: Lightning Mage
lightning_mage.desc: After striking the first target, lightning chains to one nearby enemy for 50% damage. [Apprentice Exorcist exclusive]
lightning_mage.lore: A lightning mage in cobalt robes with golden lightning embroidery, blue current flowing from fingertips.

prayer_herald.name: Prayer Herald
prayer_herald.desc: Emits prayer waves to increase the attack power of allies in range by 8%. [Novice Exorcist exclusive]
prayer_herald.lore: A neat young herald in white priest robes holding a golden cross bell.

relic_keeper.name: Relic Keeper
relic_keeper.desc: Uses holy relic power to increase the attack speed of allies in range by 10%. [Novice Priest exclusive]
relic_keeper.lore: A keeper in a platinum chainmail cloak carrying a reliquary on shoulders.

ward_scribe.name: Ward Scribe
ward_scribe.desc: Inscribes sealing wards to reduce the movement speed of enemies in range by 15%. [Novice Exorcist exclusive]
ward_scribe.lore: A scribe in deep blue scholar robes with ward scrolls, inscribing runes at fingertips.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.desc: Every 5th attack triggers a holy strike that deals 3x damage and stuns.
paladin.lore: A paladin in platinum full plate armor with a holy hammer and a faint halo.

crusader.name: Blood Knight
crusader.desc: Delivers an execution strike, dealing more damage as enemy HP decreases.
crusader.lore: A blood knight in a crimson cloak with a twin-handed execution sword, bloodstains on the blade.

midas.name: Golden Midas
midas.desc: Coats attacks in gold, gaining a large 15 SE on kill.
midas.lore: An incarnation of wealth in a golden mask and gilded armor, scattering gold dust from fingertips.

philosopher.name: Void Sage
philosopher.desc: Applies a corrosion curse on each hit that permanently reduces enemy defense by 1.
philosopher.lore: An elderly sage in star-patterned black robes with an open book of the void.

illusion.name: Illusionist
illusion.desc: Confuses the mind, with a 20% chance to make enemies lose their way and wander.
illusion.lore: An illusionist in a rainbow veil and mask, with faint afterimages flickering around.

reflection.name: Master of Reflection
reflection.desc: Fires crystal shards that bounce between multiple enemies on impact.
reflection.lore: A master in crystal armor with a polyhedral crystal staff, light scattering into rainbows.

executor.name: Underworld Executor
executor.desc: Shakes the scales of fate, with a 10% chance to return enemies to the starting point.
executor.lore: An executor in a black executioner mask holding the scales of fate, in deep purple robes.

binder.name: Soul Binder
binder.desc: Connects the souls of multiple enemies, making them share a portion of damage received.
binder.lore: A silent binder in grey-purple robes with soul chains wrapped around both hands.

grandsealer.name: Grand Sealer
grandsealer.desc: Fires sealing talismans that disable the special abilities of enemies.
grandsealer.lore: A grand sealer in white clothing with golden embroidery, sealing talismans floating in the air.

flamemaster.name: Flame Talisman Master
flamemaster.desc: Leaves a burning carpet on the ground that deals continuous burn damage.
flamemaster.lore: A master in red-black robes with bundles of burning talismans, embers spreading with every step.

vajra.name: Vajrapani
vajra.desc: Crits with a holy trident to significantly push back all nearby enemies.
vajra.lore: A muscular warrior with a golden trident, with a vajra seal glowing on forehead.

saint.name: Saint of Resonance
saint.desc: Rings a holy bell to create a shockwave that stuns all enemies in a small area.
saint.lore: A saint in white priest robes carrying a giant holy bell, air vibrating with the sound.

voidsniper.name: Void Sniper
voidsniper.desc: Fires bullets across the entire map to snipe the enemy closest to the portal.
voidsniper.lore: A sniper in a black cloak with a long void rifle, a starlight monocle on one eye.

thousandhand.name: Thousand-Hand Archer
thousandhand.desc: Pours down a barrage of arrows on multiple targets simultaneously.
thousandhand.lore: A golden archer drawing many bows at once with multiple arms.

absolutezero.name: Absolute Zero Mage
absolutezero.desc: Chance to instantly execute frozen enemies with 20% or less HP.
absolutezero.lore: A mage in a blue robe with a frost crystal crown, ice forming at every step.

permafrost.name: Frost Maiden
permafrost.desc: Summons a continuous blizzard that heavily slows all enemies in a wide area.
permafrost.lore: A maiden in a silver-white dress with a snowflake veil, a blizzard swirling from fingertips.

hellfire.name: Hellfire Alchemist
hellfire.desc: Burning enemies explode on death, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
hellfire.lore: A mad alchemist in a dark red leather apron holding explosive flasks in both hands.

phoenix.name: Phoenix Summoner
phoenix.desc: Calls down a phoenix that leaves a high-damage flame path behind the target.
phoenix.lore: A summoner in crimson and golden feather cloak, a small phoenix perched on shoulder.

abyssal.name: Abyssal Slayer
abyssal.desc: Harvests souls precisely, gaining 1.5x SE on kill.
abyssal.lore: A slayer in black armor with a soul harvesting scythe, purple mist flowing from empty eyes.

spatial.name: Spatial Slasher
spatial.desc: Summons spiritual illusions that mimic own attacks to strike multiple enemies.
spatial.lore: A slasher in silver armor with a curved dimensional blade, cracks remaining where slashed.

seer.name: Seeker of Truth
seer.desc: Emits an aura that reveals stealthy or phase-shifting enemies to all allies.
seer.lore: A seeker in deep purple robes with a truth-eye talisman, the third eye on forehead glowing.

commander.name: Battle Commander
commander.desc: Inspires nearby allies to increase their attack speed by 20%.
commander.lore: A commander in a red cloak with golden epaulette armor, holding a holy flag high.

wraithlord.name: Wraith Lord
wraithlord.desc: Chance to resurrect killed souls as friendly skeleton soldiers to fight together.
wraithlord.lore: A lord in a black crown and tattered wraith cloak, skeleton soldier souls floating around.

cursedshaman.name: Cursed Shaman
cursedshaman.desc: Curses enemies to permanently reduce their max HP by 5% on each hit.
cursedshaman.lore: A dark shaman in a bone mask and feather decorations, holding a black voodoo doll.

rampart.name: Sacred Rampart
rampart.desc: Defends the portal, returning reaching enemies to start point with 100% chance (5 charges).
rampart.lore: A solid rampart in white armor with a giant golden tower shield, motionless and firm.

judgment.name: Knight of Judgment
judgment.desc: Strikes down holy light that deals area damage to all enemies around the target.
judgment.lore: A judge in platinum armor with a holy twin-handed sword, a scale halo floating above head.

scripture_knight.name: Scripture Knight
scripture_knight.desc: Swings a sword enhanced with holy scripture to strike all nearby enemies.
scripture_knight.lore: A knight in platinum armor embedded with scripture beads, swinging a consecrated light blade.

seal_warrior.name: Seal Warrior
seal_warrior.desc: 30% chance to deliver a holy strike that completely disables all enemy abilities for 3 seconds.
seal_warrior.lore: A warrior in grey-white armor engraved with sealing talismans, holding a sword wrapped in rosaries.

tome_cannon.name: Tome Cannon
tome_cannon.desc: Fires bible shells that strike multiple enemies with a powerful explosion radius.
tome_cannon.lore: A blaster using a giant open golden bible as a cannon, runes glowing on every page.

holy_burst.name: Holy Bombardier
holy_burst.desc: Summons holy energy shells that deal massive damage to all enemies within impact radius.
holy_burst.lore: A bombardier in platinum epaulette armor carrying a giant holy bombardment staff.

rapid_exorcist.name: Rapid Exorcist
rapid_exorcist.desc: Fires purification bolts at ultra-high speed, piercing up to 3 enemies at once.
rapid_exorcist.lore: A rapid-fire exorcist in light white priest robes holding twin pistol-type holy tools.

chain_exorcist.name: Chain Exorcist
chain_exorcist.desc: Exorcism bolts chain to 3 nearby enemies after striking the first target.
chain_exorcist.lore: An exorcist in blue priest robes with a bundle of chain talismans, chain bolts jumping from fingertips.

psalm_singer.name: Psalm Singer
psalm_singer.desc: Sings holy psalms to emit a hymn that boosts the attack power of allies in range by 15%.
psalm_singer.lore: An elegant singer in white choir gowns holding a golden psalm book.

litany_chanter.name: Litany Chanter
litany_chanter.desc: Periodically heals allies in range and boosts attack power through continuous litany.
litany_chanter.lore: A chanter in blue-grey priest robes with rosaries wrapped around hands, constantly chanting prayers.

relic_guardian.name: Reliquary Guardian
relic_guardian.desc: Guards a holy relic to reduce the cooldown of allies in range by 15%.
relic_guardian.lore: A majestic guardian in a golden breastplate holding a reliquary cross.

rune_crafter.name: Rune Crafter
rune_crafter.desc: Inscribes holy runes to periodically grant buffs to allies in range.
rune_crafter.lore: A crafter in a leather apron with a rune chisel and hammer, inscribing glowing runes in the air.

barrier_master.name: Barrier Master
barrier_master.desc: Deploys a powerful barrier to reduce the attack speed of enemies in range by 25%.
barrier_master.lore: A calm master in blue-white scholar robes holding a barrier formation fan.

divine_barrier.name: Divine Barrierist
divine_barrier.desc: Creates a divine barrier that reduces enemy defense by 20% and suppresses movement speed.
divine_barrier.lore: A barrierist in a platinum cloak with holy shield talismans, light barriers spreading from palms.

storm_caller.name: Storm Caller
storm_caller.desc: On hit, drops additional lightning on a random enemy in range for 60% damage.
storm_caller.lore: A summoner in grey-blue robes with a lightning-patterned hood, holding a floating lightning sphere.

thunder_judge.name: Thunder Judge
thunder_judge.desc: Lightning chains up to 3 enemies. Damage reduces to 50% for each chain.
thunder_judge.lore: A judge in a black cloak with a golden lightning scepter, lightning jumping from eyes.

transmuter.name: Void Transmuter
transmuter.desc: Completely transmutes spirits, gaining 25 SE on every kill.
transmuter.lore: A transmuter in lead-colored plate armor with an emerald reactor, floating mechanical arms, and antenna crystals.

oracle.name: Eternal Oracle
oracle.desc: Fires cosmic projectiles that temporarily stop enemy movement on hit.
oracle.lore: A cosmic oracle in star-studded indigo robes, with the Eye of Eternity replacing the face and 8 orbiting stars.

warden.name: Abyssal Warden
warden.desc: Periodically opens a black hole to pull all enemies on screen to the center.
warden.lore: A warden in black steel armor with purple chains, a sucking black hole core in chest, and a golden key.

cursed_talisman.name: Cursed High Priest
cursed_talisman.desc: Marks enemies with death. A giant explosion occurs when the marked soul perishes.
cursed_talisman.lore: A high priest in blood-red vestments and deep hood, with a giant flag of the evil eye and floating cursed scrolls.

asura.name: Hell-Crushing Asura
asura.desc: Instantly pours 12 consecutive shockwaves on nearby targets. (Total Damage 5,400)
asura.lore: A blood-red demon king with 6 arms holding scimitars and vajras, a golden crest on chest and a ruby in the horn crown.

piercing_shadow.name: Soul-Piercing Shadow
piercing_shadow.desc: Fires a massive beam of light that pierces through all enemies on its path.
piercing_shadow.lore: A shadow sniper in purple soul armor with 5 orbiting shadow needles, soul light glowing from within the hood.

cocytus.name: Ruler of Cocytus
cocytus.desc: Uses ultimate frost magic to freeze all enemies on screen for 5 seconds.
cocytus.lore: Ruler in blue priest robes and absolute zero crown, with a giant ice crystal above head and a frost dragon scepter.

purgatory.name: Eternal Purgatory Flame
purgatory.desc: Burns an entire lane, dealing permanent burn damage to all enemies passing through.
purgatory.lore: A ruler in white armor with holy flame wings and twin torch scepters, 5 fire crowns rising from the head.

reaper.name: Nightmare Reaper
reaper.desc: Instantly harvests the soul of the enemy with the highest HP on map. (Absolute Instakill)
reaper.lore: An incarnation of death in a pitch-black cloak with a purple scythe, 5 souls floating around.

doom_guide.name: Bringer of Doom
doom_guide.desc: Purifies the portal. Enemies reaching the portal restore 5% Erosion instead of dealing damage.
doom_guide.lore: A guide in dark wraith robes with the shadow of a ghost ship behind, holding a golden lantern and purple rod.

forsaken_king.name: King of the Forsaken
forsaken_king.desc: Summons friendly specters at the start of every stage to fight for allies.
forsaken_king.lore: A king in purple armor with a golden breastplate and flowing cloak, holding a green glowing cursed greatsword.

void_gatekeeper.name: Void Gatekeeper
void_gatekeeper.desc: Passively seals the gate, reducing all damage taken by Portal Erosion by 50%.
void_gatekeeper.lore: A gatekeeper whose body is a giant slate gate, with a swirling cyan portal, floating eyes, and horned helmet.

eternal_wall.name: Eternal Guardian Wall
eternal_wall.desc: Emits a powerful stabilizing aura that slows all enemies on map by 80%.
eternal_wall.lore: An eternal guardian with a giant wall shield and warhammer, a blue cross on chest and battlements on head.

word_of_god.name: Word of God
word_of_god.desc: Releases the final word recorded in the bible, delivering holy judgment to all enemies on screen.
word_of_god.lore: An angel in glowing golden armor with feathered wings, a floating giant bible, and a golden halo.

genesis_strike.name: King of Genesis
genesis_strike.desc: Strikes all enemies on screen with an explosion of creation energy, with a 40% chance to instakill.
genesis_strike.lore: A cosmic emperor with a 7-colored gem crown and multi-colored wings, handling spheres of creation.

exorcism_storm.name: Exorcism Storm
exorcism_storm.desc: Continuously fires infinitely chaining exorcism bolts to attack all enemies on screen simultaneously.
exorcism_storm.lore: An eternal stormcaller in a cyan lightning wing cloak holding storm scepters in both hands, with glowing twin horns.

divine_choir.name: Divine Choir
divine_choir.desc: Spreads holy energy across the entire battlefield through heavenly choir, buffing allies and weakening enemies.
divine_choir.lore: A holy conductor with giant golden feathered wings and a vast halo, accompanied by floating ghost singers.

sacred_reliquary.name: Sacred Reliquary Guardian
sacred_reliquary.desc: Summons a sacred reliquary on the battlefield to boost all ally stats and continuously weaken enemies.
sacred_reliquary.lore: A reliquary guardian in marble armor and sun halo helmet, holding a floating golden ark between pillars.

grand_ward.name: Grand Ward Master
grand_ward.desc: Spreads a vast ward over the battlefield to greatly weaken all enemy stats and block movement.
grand_ward.lore: A master of golden wards with a triple barrier sphere above head and orbiting cyan hexagonal runes.

thunder_lord.name: Thunder Lord
thunder_lord.desc: On hit, drops additional lightning on 3 random enemies in range for 40% damage and 25% chance to stun for 0.8s.
thunder_lord.lore: A thunder lord in dark blue storm cloud armor with a golden lightning spear, a rotating thunder crown, and thunder wings.

shrine_might.name: Shrine of Might
shrine_might.desc: Increases attack power of nearby allies by 20%.
shrine_might.demoDesc: Decreases attack power of all allies on map by 20%.
shrine_might.lore: A shrine inhabited by the fighting spirit of ancient warriors. Its energy sharpens nearby weapons.

shrine_speed.name: Shrine of Speed
shrine_speed.desc: Increases attack speed of nearby allies by 20%.
shrine_speed.demoDesc: Decreases attack speed of all allies on map by 20%.
shrine_speed.lore: A shrine where heavenly winds reside. Its energy makes allies' hand movements dazzlingly fast.

shrine_range.name: Shrine of Insight
shrine_range.desc: Increases attack range of nearby allies by 50.
shrine_range.demoDesc: Decreases attack range of all allies on map by 50.
shrine_range.lore: A shrine of insight that sees through all things. Provides allies with spiritual vision to see further.

shrine_wisdom.name: Shrine of Wisdom
shrine_wisdom.desc: Increases crit chance of nearby allies by 10%.
shrine_wisdom.demoDesc: Decreases crit chance of all allies on map by 10%.
shrine_wisdom.lore: A shrine of insight that identifies weaknesses. Helps allies strike the enemy's core accurately.

shrine_greed.name: Shrine of Greed
shrine_greed.desc: Nearby allies gain 2 additional SE on kill.
shrine_greed.demoDesc: SE gained on kill decreases by 2 for all allies on map.
shrine_greed.lore: A shrine of secret arts that extracts more soul essence. Gain more energy as a reward for purification.

shrine_purity.name: Shrine of Purity
shrine_purity.desc: On kill, nearby allies have a 5% chance to purify 1% Portal Erosion.
shrine_purity.demoDesc: On kill, all allies on map have a 2% chance to increase Portal Erosion by 1%.
shrine_purity.lore: A shrine of purification that washes away impurity. Constantly flows holy water to keep the ward clean.

shrine_divine.name: Shrine of Archangel
shrine_divine.desc: Increases attack power of all allies on map by 30%. (Stackable)
shrine_divine.demoDesc: Decreases attack power of all allies on map by 30%.
shrine_divine.lore: A giant shrine inhabited by the protection of an archangel. Its presence gives courage to all exorcists' souls.

shrine_eternity.name: Shrine of Eternity
shrine_eternity.desc: Decreases movement speed of all enemies on map by 15%.
shrine_eternity.demoDesc: Enemy movement speed returns to normal.
shrine_eternity.lore: A mysterious shrine that even slows the flow of time. Ties down the footsteps of evil spirits.

shrine_miracle.name: Shrine of Miracle
shrine_miracle.desc: Increases crit damage of all allies on map by 50%.
shrine_miracle.demoDesc: Decreases crit damage of all allies on map by 50%.
shrine_miracle.lore: A shrine where the miracle of purification is realized. Makes allies' attacks destroy the enemy's soul deeper.

shrine_fervor.name: Shrine of Fervor
shrine_fervor.desc: Increases crit damage of nearby allies by 15%.
shrine_fervor.demoDesc: Decreases crit damage of nearby allies by 15%.
shrine_fervor.lore: A shrine where wrath and passion are condensed into flames. Breathes destructive fire into exorcists' strikes.

shrine_shadow.name: Shrine of Shadow
shrine_shadow.desc: Increases crit chance of nearby allies by 8%.
shrine_shadow.demoDesc: Decreases crit chance of nearby allies by 8%.
shrine_shadow.lore: A shrine inhabited by the crescent moon shining in the dark. Energy flowing through shadows increases strike precision.

shrine_harvest.name: Shrine of Harvest
shrine_harvest.desc: Nearby allies gain 3 additional SE on kill.
shrine_harvest.demoDesc: Additional SE gain for nearby allies vanishes.
shrine_harvest.lore: A shrine filled with golden grain. Harvests soul essence more abundantly from exorcism efforts.

shrine_endurance.name: Shrine of Endurance
shrine_endurance.desc: Increases portal purification effect of nearby allies by 3%.
shrine_endurance.demoDesc: Decreases portal purification effect of nearby allies.
shrine_endurance.lore: A shrine where mountain-like patience is crystallized. Constantly supplies purification energy to guard the ward.

shrine_valor.name: Shrine of Valor
shrine_valor.desc: Increases attack power of nearby allies by 15%.
shrine_valor.demoDesc: Decreases attack power of nearby allies by 15%.
shrine_valor.lore: A shrine where the oaths of knights fallen in holy war lie sleeping. Courage that never retreats rides on the exorcists' blades.

shrine_tempest.name: Shrine of Tempest
shrine_tempest.desc: Increases attack speed of nearby allies by 25%.
shrine_tempest.demoDesc: Decreases attack speed of nearby allies by 25%.
shrine_tempest.lore: A shrine imprisoning a storm that never subsides. The raging wind drives allies' strikes into relentless chains.

shrine_horizon.name: Shrine of Horizon
shrine_horizon.desc: Increases attack range of nearby allies by 35.
shrine_horizon.demoDesc: Decreases attack range of nearby allies by 35.
shrine_horizon.lore: A lighthouse shrine that illuminates the end of the world. It captures even the spirits beyond the distant horizon.

shrine_fortune.name: Shrine of Fortune
shrine_fortune.desc: Increases crit chance of nearby allies by 12%.
shrine_fortune.demoDesc: Decreases crit chance of nearby allies by 12%.
shrine_fortune.lore: A shrine where the dice of fate came to rest. It gifts allies a scale of probability tilted in their favor.

shrine_ruin.name: Shrine of Ruin
shrine_ruin.desc: Increases crit damage of nearby allies by 25%.
shrine_ruin.demoDesc: Decreases crit damage of nearby allies by 25%.
shrine_ruin.lore: A shrine raised from the rubble of a collapsed cathedral. The memory of ruin awakens with every strike.

shrine_omen.name: Shrine of Omen
shrine_omen.desc: Increases crit damage of nearby allies by 12%.
shrine_omen.demoDesc: Decreases crit damage of nearby allies by 12%.
shrine_omen.lore: A shrine inhabited by a black bird that foretells disaster. Evil spirits are shown their own end in advance.

shrine_tithe.name: Shrine of Tithe
shrine_tithe.desc: Nearby allies gain 4 additional SE on kill.
shrine_tithe.demoDesc: Additional SE gain for nearby allies vanishes.
shrine_tithe.lore: A shrine built from the accumulated tithes of the faithful. Offered devotion returns as soul essence.

shrine_solace.name: Shrine of Solace
shrine_solace.desc: Increases portal purification effect of nearby allies by 4%.
shrine_solace.demoDesc: Decreases portal purification effect of nearby allies.
shrine_solace.lore: A shrine where weary souls rest at last. Its quiet solace slowly closes the wounds of the ward.

normal.name: Whispering Soul
normal.desc: A common soul wandering the abyss.
normal.lore: A soul that could not let go of its lingering attachments to the living world.

memory.name: Faded Memory
memory.lore: An afterimage left by a strong desire to live.

shade.name: Flickering Shadow
shade.lore: A fragment barely maintaining its existence.

tank.name: Ironclad Specter
tank.lore: Heavy sins from life have taken form.

runner.name: Accelerated Shadow
runner.desc: A shadow rushing towards the portal.
runner.lore: A flame of hatred that burned for a lifetime.

greedy.name: Greedy Poltergeist
greedy.desc: Drops a large amount of SE upon death.
greedy.lore: A soul with a lingering obsession with gold.

lightspeed.name: Desperate Herald
lightspeed.desc: Runs at a very high speed.

echo_soul.name: Echo Soul
echo_soul.desc: Moves while leaving its own afterimages.
echo_soul.lore: An echo of an indelible memory.

hungry_ghost.name: Hungry Ghost
hungry_ghost.lore: An incarnation of unfulfilled desire during life.

aggrieved.name: Aggrieved Soul
aggrieved.lore: An unfair death has made it hardened.

split_soul.name: Split Soul
split_soul.desc: Splits into two remaining spirits upon death.
split_soul.lore: A tragedy where a single soul was split in two.

cursed_ancestor.name: Cursed Ancestor
cursed_ancestor.desc: Weakens the effects of nearby shrines.
cursed_ancestor.lore: An ancestral spirit who cast a curse on descendants.

shadow_wisp.name: Shadow Wisp
shadow_wisp.desc: Remnants of darkness mimicking a form.
shadow_wisp.lore: A being that couldn't even become a shadow — the weakest of evil spirits wandering formlessly in the dark.

cursed_shade.name: Cursed Shade
cursed_shade.desc: A specter with curse patterns engraved on its body.
cursed_shade.lore: A curse formed from resentment clings to the soul, wandering the world with its weight and envying the living.

soul_hound.name: Soul Hound
soul_hound.desc: Chases the scent of the living souls.
soul_hound.lore: Hunting instincts remain even after death, constantly chasing the scent of the living souls.

defiled_apprentice.name: Defiled Apprentice
defiled_apprentice.lore: The price for touching forbidden arts.

mimic.name: Mimic Specter
mimic.lore: Appears in the form most longed for.

deceiver.name: Siren of Despair
deceiver.lore: A master of lies who has never shown its face.

cursed_vajra.name: Corrupted Monk
cursed_vajra.lore: His mace now crushes the living.

betrayer_blade.name: Shadow Betrayer
betrayer_blade.lore: A shadow of the blade that stabbed an ally.

void_piercer.name: Betrayer Archer
void_piercer.desc: Evades ranged attacks with a 50% chance.
void_piercer.lore: Abandoned the bow and chose the abyss.

oblivion_wraith.name: Oblivion Wraith
oblivion_wraith.lore: A being that becomes invincible within oblivion.

unrepentant.name: Unrepentant Soul
unrepentant.desc: Evades ranged attacks with a 60% chance.
unrepentant.lore: The last pride of one who died without repentance.

lost_child.name: Lost Child Soul
lost_child.desc: The soul of a child who died while lost.
lost_child.lore: The soul of a child who died while lost — still wandering the dark abyss looking for home.

grave_walker.name: Grave Walker
grave_walker.desc: A soul wandering between others' graves.
grave_walker.lore: Unable to remember its own grave, it wanders between others' graves eternally.

wailing_mother.name: Wailing Mother
wailing_mother.desc: The sorrow of losing a child has turned into resentment.
wailing_mother.lore: The soul of a mother whose sorrow for her lost child turned into resentment, pouring wrath upon all living things.

boar.name: Wild Avenger
boar.lore: The thirst of a violent hunter.

soul_eater.name: Soul Eater
soul_eater.lore: Hungers for the power of exorcists.

frost.name: Cocytus Wanderer
frost.desc: Increases the speed of nearby enemies.

frost_outcast.name: Frozen Heart
frost_outcast.lore: A heart already frozen before coming to the abyss.

ember_hatred.name: Flame of Hatred
ember_hatred.lore: A flame of hatred that burned for a lifetime.

abyss_sentinel.name: Abyss Sentinel
abyss_sentinel.desc: Continuously recovers a small amount of HP.
abyss_sentinel.lore: The sentinel who guarded the gates of the abyss.

fear_harvester.name: Fear Harvester
fear_harvester.desc: Decreases the attack speed of nearby units.
fear_harvester.lore: An evil spirit that feeds on fear.

blood_spirit.name: Blood Spirit
blood_spirit.desc: Enrages and increases defense upon taking damage.
blood_spirit.lore: An evil spirit formed from blood spilled on the battlefield.

imp.name: Imp
imp.desc: The weakest demon that swarms and causes trouble.
imp.lore: The lowest rank of the demon hierarchy — small and weak, but survives through annoying pranks and quick footwork.

hellspawn.name: Hellspawn
hellspawn.desc: A cruel demon newly born in hell.
hellspawn.lore: A demon newly born in hell — though its power is weak, its cruelty is innate.

brimstone_fiend.name: Brimstone Fiend
brimstone_fiend.desc: A fiend smelling of sulfur with hellfire engraved on its body.
brimstone_fiend.lore: A fiend smelling of sulfur with hellfire engraved on its skin — rumor has it that flesh burns upon approach.

heavy.name: Chain Executor
heavy.lore: An executor bound by the chains he used to use.

burning.name: Regenerator of Pain
burning.lore: Pain that has become the driving force of regeneration.

shadow_titan.name: Shadow Titan
shadow_titan.lore: The oldest shadow form in the abyss.

lava_lord.name: Lava Lord
lava_lord.desc: Increases speed of nearby enemies upon taking damage.
lava_lord.lore: A lord of wrath forged from magma.

time_ravager.name: Time Ravager
time_ravager.desc: Decreases the attack speed of all nearby units.
time_ravager.lore: A being that steals and feeds on time.

void_master.name: Void Master
void_master.desc: Has a 20% chance to nullify all damage.
void_master.lore: The void itself has gained a will.

sin_incarnate.name: Incarnation of Sin
sin_incarnate.desc: Defense increases as more damage is taken.
sin_incarnate.lore: All the sins of humanity have gathered as one.

gold.name: Golden Afterimage
gold.desc: Gives a massive amount of SE.
gold.lore: The remnants of a king's shining treasure.

mini_cerberus.name: Mini Cerberus
mini_cerberus.lore: A small but fierce bridgehead of the abyss.

charon.name: Charon
charon.lore: The boatman who harvests souls directly.

mini_beelzebub.name: Mini Beelzebub
mini_beelzebub.lore: A smaller form of the Lord of Decay.

beelzebub.name: Beelzebub
beelzebub.lore: The Lord of Flies born from decay.

lucifer.name: Lucifer
lucifer.lore: The one who pulls all light into the abyss.

mini_lilith.name: Mini Lilith
mini_lilith.lore: An illusion sent by the Night Queen.

abyssal_overlord.name: Abyssal Overlord
abyssal_overlord.lore: An ancient being ruling the abyss.

lilith.name: Lilith
lilith.lore: The Night Queen reigning over the abyss.

mini_chronos.name: Mini Chronos
mini_chronos.lore: Flows time backward to reverse wounds.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.lore: Those who meet its gaze turn to stone.

cursed_mask.name: Cursed Hannya Mask
cursed_mask.effect: All ally damage increases by +1% per stack.
cursed_mask.lore: A mask vibrating with the screams of thousands of forgotten souls.

spectral_lantern.name: Spectral Lantern
spectral_lantern.effect: All unit attack range increases by +5 per stack.
spectral_lantern.lore: The light of this lantern does not illuminate the path, but reveals the prey.

stygian_oar.name: Stygian Oar
stygian_oar.effect: All enemy movement speed decreases by 5% per stack.
stygian_oar.lore: An oar that controls the speed of the boat crossing the river. Now it slows the time of the living.

cerberus_fang.name: Cerberus Fang
cerberus_fang.effect: All ally attack power increases by 8% per stack.
cerberus_fang.lore: The sharp teeth of hell's gatekeeper. Grants the power to tear the essence of enemies.

gluttony_crown.name: Crown of Gluttony
gluttony_crown.effect: Appearance probability of treasure ghosts increases by 2% per stack.
gluttony_crown.lore: A cursed crown that makes one crave for more.

fallen_wings.name: Fallen Angel Wings
fallen_wings.effect: Critical hit chance increases by 6% per stack.
fallen_wings.lore: Pure feathers of darkness. Guides to strike the most vulnerable parts of the soul.

spectral_chain.name: Chain of the Cursed
spectral_chain.effect: Slow effects become 2% stronger per stack.
spectral_chain.lore: The more the enemies resist, the tighter the chain tightens.

unholy_grail.name: Unholy Grail
unholy_grail.effect: Portal erosion increases 5% slower per stack.
unholy_grail.lore: Filled with the tears of those who failed to guard the gate.

sacred_incense.name: Purifying Incense
sacred_incense.effect: Summon cost reduction increases by 2 SE per stack.
sacred_incense.lore: A scent that repels unholy energy. Eases the ritual of summoning.

execution_mark.name: Executioner's Mark
execution_mark.effect: Instantly executes enemies with HP below 1% per stack.
execution_mark.lore: For those marked, the judgment of the abyss is an inescapable fate.

cursed_coin.name: Cursed Gold Coin
cursed_coin.effect: SE refunded upon selling units increases by 2% per stack.
cursed_coin.lore: Betrayal has its price, and this coin makes that price a little sweeter.

abyssal_compass.name: Abyssal Compass
abyssal_compass.effect: All ally attack range increases by +5 per stack.
abyssal_compass.lore: Points in the direction where the abyssal energy flows. Allows capturing enemy locations from further away.

abyssal_lantern.name: Abyssal Lantern
abyssal_lantern.effect: All ally attack power increases by +2% per stack.
abyssal_lantern.lore: A lantern that illuminates ally fighting spirit even in the abyssal darkness.

abyssal_fragment.name: Abyssal Fragment
abyssal_fragment.effect: All ally attack speed explodes to 2x for 5 seconds every 30 seconds. Activation cycle -3s per stack (min 15s).
abyssal_fragment.lore: A fragment that fell from the Heart of Abyss. Periodically warps surrounding time to accelerate all strikes.

pitch_black_gem.name: Pitch Black Gem
pitch_black_gem.effect: Each attack on an enemy accumulates Void Marks, increasing damage taken by 20% per mark. Max 3 marks + 1 per stack (expires if not attacked for 4s).
pitch_black_gem.lore: A gem that absorbs all light. Once engraved, that darkness penetrates deep into the enemy's soul and does not disappear.

soul_link.name: Soul Link
soul_link.effect: Each ally increases attack power by 5% per stack for each adjacent unit.
soul_link.lore: An invisible bond between exorcists and guardians. The closer they gather, the stronger the soul resonance.

immortal_remains.name: Immortal Remains
immortal_remains.effect: Portal erosion increase amount decreases by 5% per stack.
immortal_remains.lore: The remains of one who rejected death. Strengthens the sacred barrier to resist erosion.

foresight_eye.name: Eye of Foresight
foresight_eye.effect: Shrine effect values are strengthened by 15% per stack. (Range expands in cross direction from 1 stack)
foresight_eye.lore: Beyond the invisible threads of causality, it even draws upon energy that does not exist.

void_heart.name: Void Heart
void_heart.effect: All ally attack power increases by 12% per stack. Abyssal core energy dwells within exorcists.
void_heart.lore: A heart harvested from the center of the void. Each of its beats adds destructive power to all exorcist attacks.

ancient_seal.name: Ancient Seal
ancient_seal.effect: Portal erosion increase amount decreases by 4% per stack. An ancient protection barrier guards the gate.
ancient_seal.lore: A seal engraved by a great exorcist of the primordial era. Suppresses the infiltration of evil from the source.

crimson_vial.name: Crimson Vial
crimson_vial.effect: Summon cost decreases by 3 SE per stack.
crimson_vial.lore: A bottle containing sacred medicine used in ancient rituals. Relieves the fatigue of the summoning ritual.

echo_gem.name: Echo Gem
echo_gem.effect: Critical hit chance increases by 4% per stack.
echo_gem.lore: A gem where the painful echoes of souls have crystallized. Grants the sense to pierce enemy weaknesses.

whispering_dust.name: Whispering Dust
whispering_dust.effect: All shrine aura range increases by +3 per stack.
whispering_dust.lore: Traces of shrine incense ash scattered by the wind. Carries sacred energy far away.

weeping_charm.name: Weeping Charm
weeping_charm.effect: SE gained upon killing enemies increases by +1 per stack.
weeping_charm.lore: A charm soaked with the tears of the bereaved. The resentment of the departed soul returns as a reward.

demon_horn.name: Demon Horn
demon_horn.effect: 【Pact】 All ally damage +25% per stack, portal erosion +0.4%/s accumulates every second. Damage bonus doubles above 50% erosion (Madness Triggered).
demon_horn.lore: The broken horn of a demon lord. It flows hell's madness to the holder, promising greater power to more corrupted souls. The price is the portal's erosion — your time.

pestilence_censer.name: Pestilence Censer
pestilence_censer.effect: All enemy max HP decreases by 2% per stack.
pestilence_censer.lore: An incense burner that constantly vomits black smoke. That smoke eats away at everything living.

chained_obsidian.name: Chained Obsidian
chained_obsidian.effect: All enemy movement speed decreases by 3% per stack.
chained_obsidian.lore: A lump of obsidian wrapped in demonic chains. It even drags down and weighs heavily on the surrounding time.

infernal_ledger.name: Infernal Ledger
infernal_ledger.effect: +500 SE claimed every 100 kills. Threshold -10 kills per stack (min 50), reward +100 SE.
infernal_ledger.lore: A ledger where all transactions of hell are recorded. Once a certain number of souls gather, the creditor personally claims the reward.

bleeding_eye.name: Bleeding Eye
bleeding_eye.effect: Instantly executes enemies with HP below 2% per stack.
bleeding_eye.lore: A demonic eye that constantly bleeds tears of blood. Pierces the fate of the weak at a glance.

oblivion_pendant.name: Oblivion Pendant
oblivion_pendant.effect: All shrine aura range increases by +5 per stack.
oblivion_pendant.lore: A pendant engraved with the symbol of a forgotten god. Spreads the domain of divinity wider.

night_queen_crown.name: Crown of the Night Queen
night_queen_crown.effect: Critical hit damage increases by 40% per stack.
night_queen_crown.lore: The black thorn crown that Lilith placed on her head. Her gaze never missed the most fatal spot.

gorgon_gaze.name: Gorgon's Gaze
gorgon_gaze.effect: Slow effects become 6% stronger per stack.
gorgon_gaze.lore: A charm inhabited by Medusa's eye. Enemies who face it stiffen as if turned to stone, unable to take even a step.

chronos_hourglass.name: Hourglass of Chronos
chronos_hourglass.effect: All unit attack speed increases by 12% per stack.
chronos_hourglass.lore: Remnants of the hourglass that Chronos shattered to pieces. Warps the flow of time to make allies' tempo faster.

thunder_chain.name: Thunder Chain
thunder_chain.effect: Upon a critical hit, chain lightning jumps to the nearest enemy, dealing 20% damage. Additional jump +1 per stack (max 5).
thunder_chain.lore: A chain where Tartarus's lightning flows through souls. Once awakened, the light jumps from soul to soul.

soul_refluxor.name: Soul Refluxor
soul_refluxor.effect: 4% chance per stack on kill to restore portal erosion by the number of stacks.
soul_refluxor.lore: Flows scattered souls back into the gate, filling the cracks from the inside.

echo_sigil.name: Sigil of Echo
echo_sigil.effect: 6% chance per stack on attack to instantly fire an additional attack. (50% damage)
echo_sigil.lore: Leaves a memory of a blade swung once cutting twice. The echo never ends just once.

carnage_pulse.name: Carnage Pulse
carnage_pulse.effect: Successive kills within 2 seconds build a combo increasing all ally damage by 2% per stack. Combo resets if kills stop.
carnage_pulse.lore: The heart beats faster the more enemy blood it drinks, engraving a larger pulse with every strike of the hand.

soul_resurrection.name: Soul Resurrection
soul_resurrection.effect: The moment portal erosion reaches 100%, reverts erosion to 50% and annihilates all common enemies on screen (once per stack).
soul_resurrection.lore: There are souls that even the abyss failed to harvest just once. The one who defies that strike raises the gate back up.

mainhand.name: Staff of Doom
mainhand.label: Attack Speed Increase
mainhand.lore: A staff salvaged from the abyss. The screams of evil spirits are engraved within it.

offhand.name: Forbidden Tome
offhand.label: Critical Hit Damage
offhand.lore: A forbidden book that should not be opened. It whispers the secrets of critical hits to the reader.

scepter.name: Sacred Scepter
scepter.label: Attack Power Increase
scepter.lore: A scepter used by a high exorcist. Strikes evil spirits with sacred light.

bow.name: Soul Bow
bow.label: Critical Hit Chance
bow.lore: A bowstring woven with soul threads. Pierces enemy weaknesses accurately.

dagger.name: Silver Dagger
dagger.label: Attack Speed Increase
dagger.lore: A dagger swung faster than light. Enables swift successive strikes.

staff.name: Sage's Staff
staff.label: Critical Hit Damage
staff.lore: A staff containing long-held wisdom. Maximizes the power of critical strikes.

helmet.name: Helmet of Punishment
helmet.label: Attack Power Increase
helmet.lore: A helmet made by melting the armor of punished evil spirits. Multiplies the wearer's attack power.

armor.name: Guardian's Sacred Armor
armor.label: Portal Damage Reduction
armor.lore: Armor cast from celestial materials. Absorbs the impact dealt to the portal.

pauldrons.name: Steel Pauldrons
pauldrons.label: Portal Damage Reduction
pauldrons.lore: Firmly crafted shoulder guards. Disperses the impact dealt to the portal.

greaves.name: Sprinting Greaves
greaves.label: Range Expansion
greaves.lore: Leg armor inhabited by the wind's energy. Expands the influence of exorcists.

gloves.name: Gloves of Retribution
gloves.label: Critical Hit Chance
gloves.lore: Gloves that sharpen strikes to the extreme. Increases critical hit chance.

boots.name: Celestial Boots
boots.label: Range Expansion
boots.lore: Boots inhabited by celestial energy. Expands the attack range of allies.

necklace.name: Necklace of Blessing
necklace.label: SE Gain Bonus
necklace.lore: A necklace inhabited by a holy blessing. Harvests more SE from purification activities.

ring.name: Ring of Truth
ring.label: Treasure Discovery Chance
ring.lore: A ring that helps those who seek the truth. Increases the chance of discovering Golden Afterimages.

earring.name: Earrings of Wisdom
earring.label: Summon Cost Reduction
earring.lore: Earrings that clear the mind. Helps call exorcists with less energy.

bracelet.name: Solar Bracelet
bracelet.label: SE Gain Bonus
bracelet.lore: A bracelet where the solar warmth is felt. Harvests more souls when killing evil spirits.

belt.name: Exorcist's Belt
belt.label: Summon Cost Reduction
belt.lore: A belt worn by a veteran exorcist. Reduces unit summon costs.

cloak.name: Abyssal Cloak
cloak.label: Slow Effect Enhancement
cloak.lore: A cloak that freezes evil spirits. Makes binding effects even more powerful.
